svg.title: Share of days with net CO2 uptake (daily NEE < 0) per site-year, over the whole year and over June to August.
svg.desc: Grouped bar chart of 16 site-years (full and reliable years), grouped by site. Per site-year, the left bar (full site colour) is the share of days with daily NEE < 0 over the whole year, the right bar (lighter, hatched) the share over June to August; y axis days with net uptake (%), 0 to 100, dotted line at 50 %. At the Finnish sites the share is 18 % to 37 % of the year (n = 15) and 55 % to 91 % of June to August; Maktau 2019: 87 % and 99 %. Mean ± SD (range) of the whole year: grassland 31 % ± 4 % (25 % to 37 %, n = 11), annual crops 36 % ± 29 % (18 % to 87 %, n = 5); of June to August: grassland 70 % ± 11 % (55 % to 91 %, n = 11), annual crops 77 % ± 15 % (62 % to 99 %, n = 5). Whole year and June to August per site-year: Anttila 2022: 36 % and 78 %; Anttila 2023: 36 % and 71 %; Särkisuo 2022: 29 % and 72 %; Särkisuo 2023: 31 % and 66 %; Haltiala 2022 oats: 24 % and 62 %; Haltiala 2023 grass (failed): 25 % and 60 %; Haltiala 2024 sunflower: 24 % and 73 %; Haltiala 2025 oats: 18 % and 67 %; Qvidja 2020: 37 % and 78 %; Qvidja 2022: 29 % and 73 %; Qvidja 2023: 27 % and 57 %; Qvidja 2024: 32 % and 72 %; Qvidja 2025: 28 % and 55 %; Viikki 2024: 36 % and 91 %; Viikki 2025 faba bean: 27 % and 84 %; Maktau 2019 maize: 87 % and 99 %.
